name: Brooding Hatred raises off-hand damage and hit chance (#1805)
contract: Brooding Hatred 301251 (rank 1) and 301362 (rank 2) are SpellFamily 21 passives with EquippedItemClass -1. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_OFFHAND_DAMAGE_PCT (122), BasePoints 19 / 39 with DieSides 1 = +20 / +40 percent; AuraEffect::HandleModOffhandDamagePercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5209) calls Unit::UpdateDamagePctDoneMods(OFF_ATTACK), which multiplies the off-hand TOTAL_PCT unit mod by the aura multiplier (Unit.cpp:12777-12812) and so the calculated minimum off-hand damage (UNIT_FIELD_MINOFFHANDDAMAGE) by 1.2 / 1.4. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (333), BasePoints 2 / 5 + 1 = +3 / +6 percent, routed to melee and spell hit fields by HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4845). The dual-wield fixture (spells 201, 1180 and 674, item 25 in slot 15, item 2092 in slot 16) is the one dusk-blade.json already uses. The scenario measures the white-hit off-hand damage field; off-hand weapon spells such as Dusk Blade's off-hand strike use the same unit mod but are not exercised here.
